## kb_to_source

- Every normative claim of the 63-document corpus traced to a base clause, a variant parameter, a parameter_schema meaning, an event/measure definition, an extended rule or a tool contract; hypothetical examples use invented figures and identifiers (CLM-0001 etc.).
- Additions: none found. The calculation sheets' input notes ("as distinct from the list fee of the delivery service in the Online Orders service schedule") are definitional clarifications of "effective shipping fee", not new rules.
- Omissions / rewrites: **D1** (below).
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …"): none — no hub or fragment names another policy's tool; each tool name appears only in its own hub.
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none — no document states any customer's current claims, balances, tiers or missing entries.

### Difference list
- **D1 — omission (assembly operator), late_refund_calculation_28604bde, "How the figure is assembled", bullet 2.** Source: "The shares are multiplied together and applied once to the guarantee refund basis, giving the refunded delivery charge; they do not act on one another's results." KB keeps only "any proportion of it that is refunded is taken of the basis itself, never of another proportion's result." The visible materials no longer entail how two or more shares combine (product vs. reductions each taken of the basis), and the surviving clause, read literally, forbids the product. Whole-domain: affects every Late Delivery Claim with more than one share below 100%; in this task's world it moves the scored refund (13.58 under the source, 10.73 under the reductions reading) and through the prerequisite the Goodwill Credit (15.48 vs 18.33).

### Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts)
- N1. `item_return_required` ("must be sent back"), `unreturned_item_charge_basis` (net price) and `refund_includes_shipping_fee` keep their parameter_schema meanings and variant values although the clauses that consumed them were superseded; the KB renders them faithfully as live-looking schedule columns (return_retention_and_chargeback_terms: "Charged when a required item is not sent back | the net price of the item kept"; settlement_schedule: "Claim type refunds the order's shipping fee and surcharge with its merchandise | yes"), while recovery_policy and §7.4 mark the clauses retired and recovery_policy adds that "the charge basis … remain[s] those of the claim type". Origin is the source keeping inert parameters; not a rendering defect.
- N2. Source assembly sentences necessarily name kinds of modifiers inside the computation documents ("Where courtesy rates apply …", "any share of it that is charged", "any label saving", "any amount added to it … any multiplier"); the time_since_resolution_share factor quotes the source's "courtesy-reduced base". These are the source's own wording (render skill places the assembly in the computation document); recorded because the blind audit noted they announce that variations exist.
- N3. make_good_calculation states the two multipliers as "any multiplier acts on that whole sum" (source: "multiplied by the shopping-relationship multiplier and by the goodwill frequency multiplier"). Under the ordinary meaning of a multiplier this composes as a product and no prohibition is stated, so it is judged equivalent; recorded as a weaker form of D1's pattern.
